extraction_notes: Manufacturer branding on both pages is China Base International (CBI, www.china-base.com.hk); device is an NPN transistor in SOT-523, marking 1N, complementary to MMBT3906T.

The datasheet is two pages: p. 1 carries maximum ratings and the electrical-characteristics table (Ta = +25 degC unless otherwise specified); p. 2 is the SOT-523 package outline only. No typical-characteristics graphs are published anywhere in the document.
All electrical values are guaranteed table bounds; the datasheet publishes no typical values, so no source_kind is typical and no bound was converted to a typical value.

The hFE(3) row at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 1 V has both a 100 minimum and a 300 maximum; it is represented as two gain_points rows so both guaranteed bounds remain explicit. This matches the catalog parametric hint 100@10mA,1V.

The VBE(sat) row at IC = 10 mA, IB = 1 mA has a 0.65 V minimum and a 0.85 V maximum; it is represented as two saturation_points rows (the VCE(sat) 0.2 V maximum is repeated in both) so both guaranteed VBE(sat) bounds remain explicit.
The datasheet's second saturation-voltage parameter row is mislabeled 'Collector-emitter saturation voltage' but its symbol is VBE(sat); it was extracted as base-emitter saturation voltage.
SI units used throughout: currents in A, voltages in V, capacitances in F, transition frequency in Hz.
omission_reason: usable_curves is false because the datasheet contains no characteristic curves at all: p. 1 is tables only and p. 2 is the package outline drawing, so there is nothing to digitize (no hFE vs IC, output, saturation, or capacitance graphs). Datasheet facts outside this strict schema are also omitted, including VCBO and VEBO ratings, IC = 200 mA, PC = 150 mW, RthJA = 833 degC/W, temperature limits, ICEX and IEBO leakage, V(BR)CBO and V(BR)EBO breakdown rows, and the td/tr/ts/tf switching times.
